svg.title: Cost per event stays flat as you add rules
svg.desc: Line chart, 1 to 10 deployed rules on the x axis and model cost in US dollars per event on the y axis. Exemplar is flat at $0.00179 per event because it perceives each event once and scores every rule on the cached trace. Zero-shot prompting costs $0.0133 per rule per event, rising in a straight line to $0.1330 at 10 rules, about 74 times more. Circle markers are Exemplar, square markers are zero-shot prompting. A table with every value is in cost_vs_rules.md.
svg.text: Cost per event stays flat as you add rules

svg.text: Measured, not modelled. Exemplar: mean fast-model perception cost over 1,005 clips (16 frames each). Zero-shot:
median cost of 527 strong-model calls on the same frames. Teaching a rule is a one-time cost and is not included.
